player_prompt.intro:
Kk iga Player {player_id} ar itturar ummud n Checkers am {color}.
Ṣkkiḍ imik nnek s tzri n chess [fileRank fileRank], amedya '[b2c3]' (asggas a–h, uṭṭun n wadda 0–7).
Tawuriwin tisalanin:
  • Ṣkkiḍ s azilal ɣer zdat s 1 ma iga lexwan.
  • Ṣkkiḍ s wakal n uɣlif asenfali.
  • Iga yan uɣlif Agllid ma ikker ɣer taggara nniḍen.
